notes: Online-Banking Umsätze export "Excel (CSV-CAMT V2)": no rows above or below the table, the 17-column CSV-CAMT header, every field double-quoted (empty ones as ""), semicolons, ISO-8859-1 (ä/ö as single bytes), CRLF, booking and value dates dd.mm.yy, a signed Betrag with a comma decimal and no thousands mark ("-1150,00", "2850,00"), Waehrung EUR on every line, Info "Umsatz gebucht", newest first. No balance anywhere. The cash withdrawal has no counterparty name and an all-zero IBAN placeholder, so its words come from Verwendungszweck. Newest-first order and the file name are the commonly reported ones, not confirmed for this exact export option.
